about_short_description.short_description: Matter is a social reading app for articles, blogs, and newsletters to help users find better content online.

product.name: Matter App
product.description: A mobile and web application that allows users to discover, read, and listen to articles, blogs, and newsletters with features for highlighting, organizing, and offline access.

product.name: Matter Web Extension
product.description: A browser extension that enables users to save articles directly from their desktop web browsers into the Matter app.

product.name: Newsletter Integration via Gmail
product.description: A feature that connects users' Gmail accounts to the Matter app to fetch and organize newsletters automatically.

product.name: Audio Highlights
product.description: A functionality that lets users highlight text while listening to articles without needing to look at the screen.

product.name: Quoteshots
product.description: A tool for creating visually formatted quote images optimized for sharing on Twitter.
